bets.question: Will Argentina win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
bets.rationale: Spain vs Argentina final Jul 19. Two elite sides; I lean marginally more to Argentina (defending champs, Messi) than market, but not enough to bet.

bets.question: Will Spain win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
bets.rationale: Complement of the Argentina view. Spain slight favorite (beat France 2-0); market fair, no edge.

bets.question: Will Lionel Messi be the top goalscorer at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
bets.rationale: Mbappe eliminated with 8 goals (France out). Messi tied at 8 but behind on assist tiebreaker. Messi wins mainly if he SCORES in the final (~coin-flip) or flips the assist tiebreaker. 61% looks high -> lean NO.

bets.question: Will Lionel Messi win the Golden Ball at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
bets.rationale: Messi is the tournament story and all-time WC top scorer; strong best-player favorite. Small risk it goes to a Spain player if Argentina loses. Slightly high but within noise -> no bet.

bets.question: Will the U.S. invade Iran before 2027?
bets.rationale: Active airstrike war but April ceasefire held and Trump signaled reluctance for ground forces; resolution needs an actual INVASION, not strikes. ~5.5mo window. Lean NO.
